attribution.title: Ceremonial basket Konyak Naga
attribution.author: ease
attribution.description:
Ceremonial basket of the Konyak Naga (Nagaland, India) with a monkey´s skull and two human heads carved from wood. This basket is a status symbol. It may be a remembrance of the Nagas´old headhunting practices.
State Museum of Etnology, Leiden, The Netherlands.
